propositions: A prior plan-review finding with decision='block' and priority >= RECALL_MIN_PRIORITY is re-surfaced on every subsequent review with empty evidence list, causing verbatim replay even after the plan is edited to resolve it.

Recalled findings are re-verified and re-persisted indistinguishably from fresh findings because the _recall marker is dropped, causing them to re-qualify for recall in the next cycle and forming a permanent ratchet.

Pass-2 validity verification fails to reject an evidence-less recalled finding because the verifier confirms a bare assertion instead of re-grounding the original quotes against the current plan text.
Prior findings with no persisted evidence are made ineligible for recall to break the ratchet, and material_fingerprint mismatch suppresses recall to distinguish resolved edits from finder misses.

Carried evidence and impact from prior findings enable Pass-2 to re-ground recall candidates against the current plan, causing evidence-empty replays to fail verification once the underlying issue is addressed.
